claims.claim: The reviews span 2014–2026 and describe a basement unit.
claims.reason: Both the 2014 and 2026 reviews explicitly identify the space as a basement.

claims.claim: Guests widely describe the unit as clean.
claims.reason: Cleanliness is repeatedly praised across the review period.

claims.claim: Guests widely describe the unit as quiet.
claims.reason: Quiet is a recurring assessment, though two guests heard noise from upstairs.

claims.claim: Guests widely describe the unit as good value.
claims.reason: Guests repeatedly praise the price relative to the space and amenities.

claims.claim: Guests commonly report easy check-in.
claims.reason: These reviews explicitly describe simple entry or check-in; difficulty walking from parking is a distinct issue.

claims.claim: Guests find the location convenient for Asheville.
claims.reason: Multiple distinct reviews describe convenient driving access, including estimates of 15–20 minutes to downtown.

claims.claim: Guests find the location convenient for visiting the Biltmore.
claims.reason: Guests specifically identify Biltmore visits as a reason the location worked.

claims.claim: Several guests describe the accommodation as basic.
claims.reason: Descriptions include “basic,” “no frills,” and suitable mainly for sleeping and showering.

claims.claim: Some 2025 reviews use near-identical wording.
claims.reason: Several location comments are exact word-for-word repeats.

claims.claim: The repeated 2025 comments may not be independent confirmation.
claims.reason: Identical text warrants caution in weighing corroboration, but the corpus does not establish whether the accounts are independent.

claims.claim: Most reported concerns are older than 2024.
claims.reason: Most detailed complaints predate 2024; the summary correctly identifies a 2024 access complaint as an exception.

claims.claim: Guests in 2015 reported an entrance they could not lock.
claims.reason: All three describe the private entrance as unlocked and not securable by guests.

claims.claim: Guests in 2019 reported the same unlockable entrance.
claims.reason: R0045 identifies unsecured access from upstairs or the garage, not the exterior guest entrance. R0046 subsequently describes coded entry. These accounts can both be true of different doors.

claims.claim: Guests in 2015 reported missing window coverings.
claims.reason: Both explicitly report no curtains or blinds.

claims.claim: A 2019 guest reported missing window coverings.
claims.reason: There was a sheer. The supported complaint is lack of an opaque covering for privacy and light control, not absence of a covering.

claims.claim: Guests praised the private entrance.
claims.reason: Guests liked being able to enter separately; some of the same guests also noted lock limitations.

claims.claim: Guests described the area as safe.
claims.reason: These are express assessments of the neighborhood, not verification of door security.

claims.claim: One 2019 review reported spiders.
claims.reason: The guest reported two spiders in the bathroom.

claims.claim: One 2019 review reported weak water pressure.
claims.reason: The guest described weak pressure on two nights of one stay.

claims.claim: One 2019 review reported a backed-up toilet.
claims.reason: The same guest said the toilet came close to overflowing.

claims.claim: Bed sagging was a single-report concern in 2019.
claims.reason: Two separate 2019 reviews describe a bed sinking in the center and causing backache. They do not establish that multiple beds sagged.

claims.claim: One 2019 review reported audible footsteps overhead.
claims.reason: The guest said they could hear every footstep from the home above.

claims.claim: Multiple 2017 reports mention stomping.
claims.reason: R0029 is the only 2017 account of stomping in the corpus.

claims.claim: Access can involve a steep drive or an uphill walk.
claims.reason: Guests describe both the steep vehicle approach and carrying belongings uphill from designated parking.

claims.claim: A 2024 guest said the walk could be challenging for older people.
claims.reason: The reviewer specifically identifies the hill from the parking area.

claims.claim: Host feedback was mostly positive.
claims.reason: Praise for communication, accommodation and helpfulness outweighs the few adverse accounts.

claims.claim: Hosts received praise in 2026.
claims.reason: Recent guests describe the hosts as caring, helpful or responsive.

claims.claim: A few guests in 2017–2019 found the hosts aloof.
claims.reason: R0029 explicitly says “aloof.” R0041 supports the broader point about unpleasant interactions, but describes blame and abrupt messages rather than mere aloofness.

claims.claim: The reviews cannot confirm current conditions.
claims.reason: These are dated guest observations. Recent positive reviews do not check every older concern or establish conditions at the cutoff.
